Joke: Why did the magnifying glass break up with the exit sign? Because it couldn't see itself leaving!
What do you call a trash can trying to leave? Garbage out!
Why did the right arrow approve the check mark? Because it was moving in the right direction!
I tried to throw away a star but it was trash-can't!
Why did the star rate the check mark so low? It just wasn't up to par!
I asked the menu and gear icon what they wanted to eat. They said they had a lot on their plate!
Why did the home icon cross out the X icon? It didn't want to leave home!
I tried to set the settings on the magnifying glass, but it was just too focused!
Why did the 'X' get mad at the 'Next' button? Because it said, 'You're next to be deleted!'
The menu and back button had a fight, but the back button always had a way to return to the argument!
Why did the back arrow go to the home? To return to sender!
I tried to set the settings on the check mark but it was already approved!
The magnifying glass and exit sign had a disagreement. It wasn't easy to see themselves agreeing!
The star and the 'X' icon had a fight, but the star always came out on top!
The exit sign was going home, but it couldn't find its way back!
